record.question:
While managing a relief camp during a flood, you discover that one of your junior officers is diverting
       resources to his relatives. You have no concrete documentation yet but several verbal complaints. What
       is the best approach?
options: Immediately confront the officer on the spot and demand an explanation.
Ignore the matter until written proof is obtained.
Discreetly monitor the officer’s activity, document irregularities, and initiate a confidential inquiry.
Alert the media to expose the officer’s misconduct.
